name: cached-routing
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd(); base=lane.parent; root=base.parents[4]
paths=[base/'polynexus-rook-source-review-r1'/n for n in ['REVIEW.md','review.json','source-inventory.json','search-inventory.json','access-inventory.json','read-inventory.json']]+[base/'polynexus-rook-source-parent-integration-r1.json',base/'expanded-corpus-r377/registry-receipts.json']+[Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/sources')/n for n in ['upstream.json','CONTENTS.md','preprints-tree.json']]
reads=[]
for p in paths:
 if not p.is_file(): print('MISSING',p);continue
 b=p.read_bytes(); t=b.decode();reads.append({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b),'depth':'full bytes; full display except preprints path metadata filtered for target terms'})
 print('FILE',p)
 if p.name=='preprints-tree.json':
  j=json.loads(t); print('TARGET ROUTING', [x for x in j.get('tree',[]) if any(k in str(x).lower() for k in ['polynex','fikior','01863','rook','partial','monoid'])])
 else: print(t)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'cached-read-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(reads,indent=2),text=True,check=True)
